end.summary:
Practised reading and plotting points from ordered pairs on the Cartesian plane.
Identified x as horizontal movement and y as vertical movement.
Distinguished (3, 2) from (2, 3) using right/up movements.
Located points in quadrants, including negative x-values and Quadrant II.
Answered 2 of 3 point-reading attempts unaided; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised plotting ordered pairs by moving horizontally for x and vertically for y. They correctly explained that (3, 2) and (2, 3) give different locations and identified that a negative x-value means moving left. The final responses showed the distinction was retained; the teach-back was not yet complete. At home, ask them to plot three points and describe each movement aloud.
